articles.title: Bitcoin faces true demand test above $83K as liquidity thickens: Glassnode
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price analysis reveals convergence of multiple trend lines and liquidity structures around spot price, keeping upside in check.

articles.title: Tokenized deposits could raise US credit costs: Dallas Fed economists
articles.snippet: Dallas Fed economists said faster, programmable deposits could make bank funding less stable, potentially pushing lenders toward more expensive funding.

articles.title: Protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution to solve scaling bottlenecks
articles.snippet: CTDG Dev Hub participant’s protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution, allowing network nodes to reach agreement on blocks before transaction execution completes.

articles.title: SEC’s proposed crypto rules probably won’t spark new ICO boom
articles.snippet: The SEC’s ‘regulation crypto assets’ proposals could create early-round FOMO. But some tokens may still fall into the no-man’s land between security and non-security.

articles.title: Bill Gates Wants a Robot Tax and Jobs Humans Can't Be Fired From
articles.snippet: Gates is calling for AI tokens and robots to be taxed so firms think twice before swapping out workers, plus a bracket of "human reserved" roles that stay off-limits to automation.
